description: Confirms the 6-digit code that was emailed to the candidate, which opens the interview. Ask the candidate for the code; do not guess it. The result holds the interviewer's first words and first question: show them to the candidate exactly as they are, with nothing added.

session.description: The session value returned by start_job_application. Keep it for the whole interview and do not show it to anyone else.

name: confirm_job_application
